#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

DEST=${DEST:-backup-srv:/srv/nightly}
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/
scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
echo "wrote $BUNDLE to $DEST"

arguments.command:
set -eu
sh -n backup.sh
work=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$work/logs" "$work/bin"
printf 'nightly entry\n' > "$work/logs/app.log"
cp backup.sh "$work/backup.sh"
cat > "$work/bin/scp" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$SCP_ARGS"
EOF
chmod +x "$work/bin/scp"
(
  cd "$work"
  SCP_ARGS="$work/scp.args" PATH="$work/bin:$PATH" sh ./backup.sh
  test -f "logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"
  tar -tzf "logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz" | grep -Fx 'logs/app.log'
)
printf '%s\n' 'scp arguments:'
cat "$work/scp.args"
